text: dsh-http-tools 是面向 DSH 的 HTTP/API 调试工具，提供请求发送、curl 命令解析和会话内请求历史。它向 DSH tools 注册工具，可设置方法、请求头、请求体、认证和超时，并返回状态、耗时、响应头、截断后的响应体及可复用 curl 命令。用户还可查询和比较历史响应；可选 UI 包为 Web 工具调用展示可展开的响应卡片。适合需要在 DSH 对话中调用和调试 REST API 的开发者。需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本，插件配置均有默认值。

dsh-http-tools adds HTTP tools to DSH: send requests with custom methods, headers, bodies, and authentication; parse or run curl commands; and inspect or compare session history. An optional Web UI shows expandable response cards. Requires Node.js 22+.
你能帮我在 DSH 里直接请求一个 REST API 并看响应吗？
我想把 curl 命令转成结构化请求，能顺便执行吗？
怎么比较同一会话里两次 API 响应的差别？
需要查看刚才请求的状态码、耗时和响应体。
让 DSH 支持带自定义请求头和认证的 HTTP 调用。
Can I send REST requests and inspect their responses from a DSH conversation?
I want to paste a curl command, review its parsed fields, and optionally run it.
dsh-http-tools 的功能「HTTP 请求」：http_request 可发送常见 HTTP 方法请求，配置 URL、请求头、请求体及认证，并返回响应状态、耗时和内容。
dsh-http-tools 的功能「curl」：curl_parse 将 curl 命令解析为方法、URL、请求头、请求体和认证信息；设置 execute 后可发送解析出的请求。
dsh-http-tools 的功能「history」：request_history 可列出当前会话请求、按序号查看单条记录，或比较两条响应的状态、耗时、大小和正文差异。
dsh-http-tools 的功能「ui」：可选 Web UI companion 为 HTTP 工具调用显示状态、方法和 URL，并展开查看响应头与响应体，提供复制正文和 curl 的操作。
dsh-http-tools 使用时会将配置的 HTTP 请求发送到调用者提供的目标 URL，并将响应内容返回给 DSH。
我想从 DSH 里检查服务是否正常，并查看接口返回的数据。

dsh-http-tools README · dsh-http-tools：> HTTP / API debugging tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

`dsh-http-tools` gives your DeepSeek Harness agent a complete REST client: send any request with full control over method, headers, body, and auth, paste a `curl` command and let the agent run or tweak it, and review or compare past requests — all inside the chat.

dsh-http-tools README · dsh-http-tools：Comes with an optional **UI companion package** (`dsh-http-tools-ui`) that renders every `http_request` / `curl_parse` call as a DeepSeek-branded card in the web UI.

dsh-http-tools README · Features：- **`http_request`** — full REST client: GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD, custom headers, body, basic/bearer auth. Returns status, duration, size, response headers, truncated body, and an equivalent redacted `curl` command.
- **`curl_parse`** — parse a `curl` command into structured parts, or execute it in one step (`execute: true`).
- **`request_history`** — query in-session requests, inspect one, or diff two responses.
- **Pagination-aware** — the `Link` response header is surfaced to the model, so it can follow `rel="next"` / `rel="last"` without re-reading raw headers.
- **Preview-slimmed logging** — persisted session logs carry a 6000-char body preview, so logs stay readable as request volume grows.
- **DeepSeek-branded UI cards** (with `dsh-http-tools-ui`) — fish logo, brand-colored method badge, official state dot (running chase animation), theme-aware colors, collapsible JSON body (JsonTree), and copy-body / copy-curl buttons.

dsh-http-tools README · Tools：| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `http_request` | Send an HTTP request (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD) with custom headers, body, and auth. Returns status, duration, size, response headers, truncated body, and an equivalent `curl` command. |
| `curl_parse` | Parse a `curl` command into its structured parts (method, URL, headers, body, auth). Optionally execute it in one step with `execute: true`. |
| `request_history` | Query requests made in the current session, inspect one in detail, or compare two responses side by side. |

dsh-http-tools README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-http-tools

dsh-http-tools README · optional: DeepSeek-branded UI cards for the web client：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-http-tools-ui
```

Works out of the box with zero configuration. Node.js >= 22 is required (uses the native `fetch`).

text: dsh-http-tools README · UI cards：`dsh-http-tools-ui` is a separate package that registers keyed tool views for `http_request` and `curl_parse`. Once installed, each call renders as a card in the conversation:

dsh-http-tools README · UI cards：- Fish logo + brand-colored method badge (`GET` / `POST` / …)
- Official state dot: green on success, amber on non-2xx, red on error, animated chase while running
- Status · duration · size · truncated summary on the row head
- Expandable response: key headers inline, JSON body as a collapsible tree (with copy actions), non-JSON bodies as text
- **Copy** / **Copy curl** buttons, all colors theme-aware (`--dsw-*` tokens)

dsh-http-tools README · Configuration：All options are optional. Set them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: http-tools
  name: dsh-http-tools
  config:
    maxBodyChars: 524288   # cap on response body characters returned to the model

dsh-http-tools README · Security model：- By default every URL is allowed; the request is tagged with an `X-DSH-Request` audit header so the server can identify agent traffic.
- `blockedHosts` rejects exact hostnames and their subdomains before any network I/O (e.g. block cloud metadata endpoints like `169.254.169.254`).
- `localOnly: true` restricts requests to loopback and private networks — a one-switch "local debugging mode".
- Response bodies are capped at `maxBodyChars` (default 512 KB) and timeouts at `timeoutMs` (default 10 s) so a runaway call can never flood the model context.
- Credentials (Bearer tokens, basic-auth pairs) are sent only as request headers. Generated `curl` commands redact `authorization`, `cookie`, `proxy-authorization`, and `x-api-key` values as `***`, so secrets do not leak into session logs or request history.
